summary: A November 1935 photo caption says the CCC built a 100-ft experimental tower and cabin at Mercer; no source found describes the site today.

facts.design: Experimental tower and cabin, built by the CCC of red cypress heart wood

events.note: Year of the photo caption, which says the CCC built the tower. The page gives no completion date; the caption's 100-ft figure is read here as height.

evidence.supports: CCC-built 100-ft experimental tower and cabin of red cypress heart wood
evidence.quote: Mercer Tower, 100-ft. experimental tower and cabin, built by the CCC of red cypress heart wood.

sources.title: Mercer Fire Tower Map - Liberty, Florida, United States

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources. The 1935 year is the photo caption date; no completion date is documented. The caption's 100-ft figure is read as height, which the caption does not state outright. No source gives status, access, staffing or visit details. Mapcarta's tower point (from OpenStreetMap) shows a mapped tower at the coordinates but does not show a standing structure. The brief's coordinates match Mapcarta's (30.28242, -84.86853). Used two web searches and two page reads. A Florida forestry history booklet (Scribd) was scanned and names no Mercer tower. Consider holding the story unless an official record (a National Archives photo record, Apalachicola NF history, or a Florida Forest Service list) turns up.
